title: Registry companion 1.1.0: source statement
description: Released on registry-v1.1.0 with spec/registry-1.1.0.md, which governs where they differ. A source statement (section 10.2), closed: a repository's identity, the commit and every document's path, role and digests, with the values of the index's source item. It has no selector: it is never a file, only the JCS bytes whose digest a source signature signs.
$comment: That its values and order are the index's item's is the reader's to check.
